description: In every PA-model, the course-of-values output is the specified step applied to its parameters, current index and actual preceding history.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.courseValue_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) (k : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.courseValue h).value (Fin.snoc x k) =
    h.value
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc x k)
        ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k)))
